items.reason: A morning vitamin C serum is a gentle-enough brightening step to keep for a cosmetic routine.
A ceramide moisturizer adds comfort and softness to skin that looks dry.
Tinted mineral SPF 50 with iron oxides gives daily cover and helps keep the look of dark patches from deepening.

response.routine_note: Dark patches during pregnancy are best reviewed with your prenatal provider or a dermatologist, including whether to keep using your hydroquinone cream, so we have not added any more brightening or exfoliating products. Use the vitamin C in the morning, then moisturizer and the tinted mineral SPF, and pause the serum if skin feels stinging or tight.
